# Chrome Web Store listing

## Product details

**Name:** Sticky Reminder

**Summary (132-character limit):**

> Create one-time, daily or weekly reminders from your toolbar and receive native notifications. Private, local and open source.

**Category:** Productivity

**Language:** English

**Detailed description:**

> Sticky Reminder puts a small, focused reminder tool in your browser toolbar.
>
> Create a reminder in one click, add an optional note, choose its time, and receive a native browser notification when it is due. Reminders can run once, every day or every week. The options page lets you search, filter, complete and delete them.
>
> Private by design:
> • reminders stay in local extension storage on your device
> • no account and no cloud backend
> • no analytics, advertising or tracking
> • no access to pages you visit
> • open-source under the MIT license
>
> Sticky Reminder requests only alarms, notifications and storage. Each permission is necessary for scheduling, showing and saving your reminders.

## Privacy form

**Single purpose:** Create and manage time-based reminders, then show native
notifications when they are due.

**Remote code:** No. All executable code is included in the submitted package.

**Data usage certification:** The extension does not collect or transmit user
data. Reminder titles, notes, times and state are user-provided content handled
locally only. Select no collected-data categories in the dashboard.

**Permission justifications:**

- `alarms`: schedule one-time and repeating reminder events while the popup is
  closed.
- `notifications`: show the native notification that is the extension's single
  purpose.
- `storage`: save reminders and their state in local extension storage between
  browser sessions.

**Host permissions:** None.

**Privacy policy:** <https://sticky-reminder.pages.dev/privacy>
